H2900.def: or Towbiyahuw {to-bee-yaw'-hoo}; from «02896» and «03050»; goodness of Jehovah; Tobijah, the name of three Israelites and of one Samaritan:--Tobiah, Tobijah.

H2902.def: a primitive root; to smear, especially with lime:--daub, overlay, plaister, smut.

H2903.et: from an unused root meaning to go around or bind
H2903.def: from an unusued root meaning to go around or bind; a fillet for the forehead:--frontlet.

H2904.def: a primitive root; to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out:--carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.

H2905.et: from an unused root meaning to range in a regular manner
H2905.def: from an unused root meaning to range in a regular manner; a row; hence, a wall:--row.

H2906.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06697»; a rock or hill:--mountain.

H2907.def: a primitive root; to pounce as a bird of prey:--haste.

H2908.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02901»; hunger (as twisting):--fasting.

H2909.def: a primitive root; to stretch a bow, as an archer:--(bow-)shot.

H2910.et: from (02909) (or (02902)) in the sense of overlaying
H2910.def: from «02909» (or «02902») in the sense of overlaying; (in the plural only) the kidneys (as being covered); hence (figuratively) the inmost thought:--inward parts.

H2911.def: from «02912»; a hand mill; hence, a millstone:--to grind.

H2912.def: a primitive root; to grind meal; hence, to be a concubine (that being their employment):--grind(-er).

H2913.def: from «02912»; a hand mill; hence (figuratively) chewing:--grinding.

H2914.et: from an unused root meaning to burn
H2914.def: from an unused root meaning to burn; a boil or ulcer (from the inflammation), especially a tumor in the anus or pudenda (the piles):--emerod.

H2915.def: from (the equiv. of) «02902»; mortar or plaster:--daubing.

H2916.et: from an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky [rath perb. a demon. From (02894), through the idea of dirt to be swept away]
H2916.def: from an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky (rath. perb. a demon. from «02894», through the idea of dirt to be swept away); mud or clay; figuratively, calamity:--clay, dirt, mire.

H2917.et: perhaps, by interchange, for a word corresponding to (02916)
H2917.def: (Aramaic) perhaps, by interchange, for a word corresponding to «02916»; clay:--miry.

H2918.def: feminine of (an equivalent to) «02905»; a wall; hence, a fortress or a hamlet:--(goodly) castle, habitation, palace, row.

H2921.def: a primitive root; properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry):--clouted, with divers colours, spotted.

H2922.et: apparently from (02921) in the (orig.) sense of covering (for protection)
H2922.def: apparently from «02921» in the (orig.) sense of covering (for protection); a lamb (compare «02924»):--lamb.

H2923.def: from the plural of «02922»; lambs; Telaim, a place in Palestine:--Telaim.

H2926.def: a primitive root; properly, to strew over, i.e. (by implication) to cover in or plate (with beams):--cover.

H2927.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02926»; to cover with shade:--have a shadow.

H2928.et: from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently
H2928.def: from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression; Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper:--Telem.

H2929.def: from the same as «02728»; oppressive; Talmon, a temple doorkeeper:--Talmon.

H2930.def: a primitive root; to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated):--defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, × utterly.

H2931.def: from «02930»; foul in a relig. sense:--defiled, + infamous, polluted(-tion), unclean.

H2933.def: a collateral form of «02930»; to be impure in a religious sense:--be defiled, be reputed vile.

H2934.def: a primitive root; to hide (by covering over):--hide, lay privily, in secret.

H2935.et: from an unused root probably meaning to weave
H2935.def: from an unused root probably meaning to weave; a basket (of interlaced osiers):--basket.

H2937.def: a primitive root; to wander; ,causatively to lead astray:--seduce.

H2938.def: a primitive root; to taste; figuratively, to perceive:--X but, perceive, taste.

H2939.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02938»; to taste; causatively to feed:--make to eat, feed.

H2940.def: from «02938»; properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate:-- advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

H2941.def: (Aramaic) from «02939»; properly, a taste, i.e. (as in «02940») a judicial sentence:--account, × to be commanded, commandment, matter.

H2942.def: (Aramaic) from «02939», and equivalent to «02941»; properly, flavor; figuratively, judgment (both subjective and objective); hence, account (both subj. and obj.):--+ chancellor, + command, commandment, decree, + regard, taste, wisdom.

H2943.def: a primitive root; to load a beast:--lade.

H2944.def: a primitive root; to stab:--thrust through.

H2945.et: from (02952) (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children)
H2945.def: from «02952» (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children); a family (mostly used collectively in the singular):--(little) children (ones), families.

H2946.def: a primitive root; to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively, to nurse a child (as promotive of growth); or perhaps a denom. from «02947», from dandling on the palms:--span, swaddle.

H2947.def: from «02946»; a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm- breadth (not "span" of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm):--coping, hand-breadth.

H2950.def: a primitive root; properly, to stick on as a patch; figuratively, to impute falsely:--forge(-r), sew up.

H2951.def: of foreign derivation; a military governor:--captain.

H2952.def: a primitive root; apparently to trip (with short steps) coquettishly:--mince.

H2953.et: from a root corresponding to (06852), and meaning the same as (06856)
H2953.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «06852», and meaning the same as «06856»; a finger-nail; also a hoof or claw:--nail.

H2954.def: a primitive root; properly, apparently to be thick; figuratively, to be stupid:--be fat.

H2955.def: probably from «05197»; a dropping (of ointment); Taphath, an Israelitess:--Taphath.

H2956.def: a primitive root; to drive on; figuratively, to follow close:--continual.

H2961.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist
H2961.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist; properly, dripping; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such):--new, putrefying.

H2962.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend
H2962.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend; properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before:--before, ere, not yet.

H2963.def: a primitive root; to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels):--catch, × without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, × surely, tear (in pieces).

H2964.def: from «02963»; something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food:--leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

H2965.def: from «02963»; recently torn off, i.e. fresh:--pluckt off.

H2966.def: feminine (collectively) of «02964»; prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals:--ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

H2967.et: from a name of foreign derivation
H2967.def: (Aramaic) from a name of foreign derivation; a Tarpelite (collectively) or inhabitants of Tarpel, a place in Assyria:--Tarpelites.

H2969.def: a primitive root; to be suitable:--appertain.

H2970.def: or Ya.azanyahuw {yah-az-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «0238» and «03050»; heard of Jah; Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites:-- Jaazaniah. Compare «03153».

H2971.def: from «0215»; enlightener; Jair, the name of four Israelites:--Jair.

H2972.def: patronymically from «02971»; a Jairite or descendant of Jair:--Jairite.

H2973.def: a primitive root; properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish:--dote, be (become, do) foolish(-ly).

H2974.et: a primitive root [probably rather the same as (02973) through the idea of mental weakness]
H2974.def: a primitive root (probably rather the same as «02973» through the idea of mental weakness); properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition:--assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, × willingly, would.

H2975.def: of Egyptian origin; a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria:--brook, flood, river, stream.

H2976.def: a primitive root; to desist, i.e. (figuratively) to despond:--(cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

H2977.et: from the same root as (0803) and (03050)
H2977.def: or {yo-she-yaw'-hoo}; from the same root as «0803» and «03050»; founded of Jah; Joshijah, the name of two Israelites:-- Josiah.

H2979.def: from the same as «0871»; stepping; Jeatherai, an Israelite:--Jeaterai.

H2980.def: a primitive root; to bawl:--cry out.

H2981.def: from «02986»; produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth:--fruit, increase.

H2982.def: from «0947»; trodden, i.e. threshing-place; Jebus, the aboriginal name of Jerusalem:--Jebus.

H2983.def: patrial from «02982»; a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus:--Jebusite(-s).

H2985.def: from «0995»; intelligent; Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings:--Jabin.

H2986.def: a primitive root; properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp):--bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).

H2989.def: the same as «02988»; Jabal, an antediluvian:--Jabal.

H2991.def: from «01104» and «05971»; devouring people; Jibleam, a place in Palestine:--Ibleam.

H2992.et: a primitive root of doubtful meaning
H2992.def: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from «02993»; to marry a (deceased) brother's widow:--perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.

H2993.def: from (the orig. of) «02992»; a brother-in-law:--husband's brother.

H2994.def: feminine participle of «02992»; a sister-in-law:--brother's wife, sister in law.

H2995.def: from «01129» and «0410»: built of God; Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine:--Jabneel.

H2996.def: from «01129»; a building; Jabneh, a place in Palestine:--Jabneh.

H2997.def: from «01129» and «03050»; built of Jah; Jibnejah, an Israelite:--Ibneiah.

H2998.def: from «01129» and «03050»; building of Jah; Jibnijah, an Israelite:--Ibnijah.

H2999.def: probably from «01238»; pouring forth; Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan:--Jabbok.
